sustainability-challenges-growth-boundar.alt: An invented metro area. A river runs through the old downtown. The built-up area spreads around it, and a dashed line, the urban growth boundary, circles it with some empty land left inside. Outside the line are farms and forest. Letter W marks a rail station in a suburb. Letter X marks an empty lot inside the boundary. Letter Y marks farmland just outside the boundary. Letter Z marks an old factory site on the river near downtown.
